extra_observations.construction_error: base_input=defaults does not contain the key performance_fee_revenue, so the set_driver_element mutation raises KeyError while the case is constructed and the product is never called. This observation is therefore NOT executable as frozen; the runner records the KeyError verbatim instead of a contract fact (oracle.md r3 section, item observation-c). The factual question it was meant to answer is answered by recovery/probes/signed_driver_probe.json, which is a labelled post-hoc probe and not part of this frozen case set. No expectation, tolerance or refusal condition was changed when this annotation was added.
extra_observations.why: performance_fee_revenue is a signed driver with no lower bound, so a clawback-style negative fee passes the driver guard and is then stopped by the final non-negative-revenue guard; records the contract boundary, does not gate
